projects.title: Payments Made Easy
projects.description:
Corporate Design

During our two-year cooperation with Direct Debit Limited in the United Kingdom, we designed all the corporate brochures, catalogues, leaflets, pamphlets, fins, web banners and any other material requested by the client.

Website design and maintenance

Our responsibility was also to design, develop and maintain the Direct Debit website, a leading financial service provider in the UK, which included daily updates and tweaks.

The website was built in PHP with MySQL database and a tailor made Content Management System (CMS).
